name: Missile Downward Step Invariant
description: Verifies that an active missile at (x=10, y=5) moves down to (x=10, y=6) in a single tick.

name: Multi-Missile Independent Stepping
description: Verifies that two simultaneous active missiles advance their y-coordinates independently.

name: Bunker Defensive Shield Collision
description: Verifies that when bunkersHitCheck returns 1, the missile is extinguished (x=0) and does not advance.

name: Player Defense Cannon Direct Impact
description: Verifies that when playerHitCheck returns 1, missile is cleared and function signals player hit (return 1).

name: Screen Lower Boundary Deallocation
description: Verifies that missiles reaching or exceeding y=24 are removed from the active slot (x=0).

name: Inactive Slot Invariance
description: Verifies that unspawned missile slots (x=0) are never modified by the trajectory loop.

name: Near-Boundary Preservation
description: Verifies that a missile at y=22 advances to y=23 without prematurely clearing.

name: Bunker Hit Isolation Invariant
description: Ensures that bunker collisions do NOT signal player destruction (return 0).

name: Full 5-Missile Saturation Array
description: Verifies all 5 hardware missile slots update concurrently across the display matrix.

name: Simultaneous Bunker Collision and Free Flight
description: Verifies slot 0 hit bunker (cleared) while slot 1 advances freely.

name: Sparse Multi-Slot Stepping
description: Verifies interleaved active slots advance accurately while inactive slots remain untouched.

name: Terminal Lower Border Clearance
description: Verifies multiple missiles reaching lower boundary y=24 are extinguished in unison.

name: High-Altitude Spawn Invariant
description: Verifies newly spawned missile at screen top y=1 advances cleanly to y=2.

name: Player Defense Cannon Impact with Trailing Missiles
description: Verifies cannon direct impact triggers player hit while trailing missiles continue stepping.

name: Mid-Screen Independent Drop Triad
description: Verifies three missiles across distinct columns maintain synchronous vertical drop.

name: Full Boundary Saturation Deallocation
description: Verifies all 5 missile slots simultaneously reaching threshold y=24 are deallocated.

name: Shield Absorption on Secondary Slot
description: Verifies slot 1 bunker absorption while slot 0 continues unobstructed descent.

name: Quiescent Screen Invariant
description: Verifies empty missile hardware register remains empty with zero hits.

name: Isolated Player Destruction in Non-Zero Slot
description: Verifies player destruction signaled correctly when collision occurs in missile slot 1.

name: Complex Multi-Subsystem Interaction Invariant
description: Verifies simultaneous free-flight drop, bunker absorption, and player cannon collision across 3 slots.
